name: ScienceQA: Multimodal Question Answering with Thought Explanations
description: ScienceQA is a multimodal science question-answering benchmark containing 21,208 multiple-choice questions collected from elementary and middle school curricula. Published at NeurIPS 2022, questions span natural science, social science, and language science, annotated with structured lecture notes and step-by-step explanations to diagnose multi-hop chain-of-thought reasoning.
